conceptual_change: Incorporate a conditional order execution module that restricts market entry to signals where the signal candle close price deviates by a minimum of 0.1% beyond the SMA trigger value to filter out noisy crossovers.
rationale: Previous failure was due to a missing implementation of the signal confirmation logic. This hypothesis provides a concrete, engine-level constraint (0.1% price deviation) to operationalize the confirmation requirement defined in the baseline research.
